Ukraine's attack on Syzran refinery overnight August 8th destroyed six major units, hitting the entire production chain from crude processing to high-octane fuel production, per Exilnova+. The strike targeted primary distillation, catalytic cracking and fuel component facilities. A smoke stack collapsed directly onto the L-35/11-600 unit after a drone strike, causing major damage and taking it offline indefinitely. This is the second time this month Ukraine has targeted a complete technological chain rather than individual refinery units, maximizing damage to Russia's fuel production capacity.
